page_title: AST 0-2 ARS | Aston Villa v Arsenal 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
90+3' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.

90+1' Good touch by Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is booked.
88' It's time for a substitution. Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) comes on in place of Bukayo Saka.
87' One of the players from Aston Villa times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
86' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.
86' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.

86' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Oliver with no other option than to blow for a foul.
84' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

84' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

83' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
82' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
79' Today's match ends for Jurrien Timber who will be replaced by Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal).

77' 0 - 2 Bukayo Saka passes to Thomas Partey (Arsenal), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes inside the right post. Fabulous goal! The score is 0:2.
76' Here is a change. Lucas Digne is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa).
76' Substitution. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) on for Amadou Onana.
75' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 10:4. The current number of shots on goal is 4:2.
72' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) has tested the patience of referee Michael Oliver and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
72' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
71' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Aston Villa will have a corner.
69' The Arsenal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
67' 0 - 1 Goal! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.

66' What an opportunity! Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
65' Substitution. Gabriel Martinelli did his best and is replaced by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).
65' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. John McGinn will be replaced by Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa).
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ollie Watkins departs the field of play to be replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
64' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) dribbles into the box, but Emiliano Martinez is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
62' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) sends the corner into the box, but David Raya intercepts it and averts the threat.

61' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.
61' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Oliver blows for a foul.

58' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
58' Aston Villa win a corner.
57' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Gabriel (Arsenal) for his blatant foul.
56' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) tries to nod in the rebound, but he is denied by a reflex save from the keeper.
54' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
54' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Thomas Partey (Arsenal) commits a foul after dangerous play.
52' Michael Oliver blows for a foul after Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
52' Aston Villa are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
48' Rough tackle by William Saliba (Arsenal). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Referee Michael Oliver sees the trip by Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
45+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Declan Rice (Arsenal) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+3' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
44' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
43' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.
41' A pass from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is intercepted by David Raya and the move breaks down.
40' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.

39' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) latches onto a short pass from Gabriel Martinelli inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
37' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
34' William Saliba (Arsenal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
33' William Saliba (Arsenal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

32' Wasted opportunity! Thomas Partey (Arsenal) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
31' Declan Rice (Arsenal) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
30' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) makes a strong challenge and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
28' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

25' What a huge chance for Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
23' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) tries to find Declan Rice, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
22' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' The game is interrupted now, Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Arsenal. The possession of the ball – 33:67.
17' A player from Arsenal commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
17' The referee awards a corner and Declan Rice (Arsenal) goes over to take it.
16' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kosta Nedeljkovic is coming onto the pitch as Matty Cash (Aston Villa) cannot continue after picking up an injury.

16' Emiliano Martinez pulls off a great save to deny Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The referee blows his whistle, Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
13' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
12' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
10' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Oliver no option but to blow his whistle.
10' The Aston Villa players are exchanging some short passes.

7' Declan Rice (Arsenal) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Emiliano Martinez, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
7' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
6' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) passes the ball onto Declan Rice, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
5' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
2' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
1' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
